Consider the district's relative mildness: no local ban of its own (but national ban attached — scope unspecified), no local hostile policing documented, low-risk ranking, courts partly blocking orders, hate crime statute, employment protections. Plus facility bans in government buildings (airports? federal buildings — likely, but scope not documented for this district). Plus custody: if detained, national corrections conversion-therapy policy and men's-ward placement documented.

Combined operative regime: entry documents (national), facilities (national ban attached locally), custody (national corrections bureau), care.

I'll say 0.32.
